plain_summary_en: This paper studies Pointing to Facilitate Telepresence Robot-Mediated Participation in Hybrid Classroom Interaction. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Pointing, Facilitate, Telepresence, Robot. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
